author: Bobby Grayson
description: First two mutants I wrote (no sender check on release; release on any message while holding) were both unreachable under honest clients and explored the same state space as the original. The invariant predicted this: r c p = 0 for non-holders, and no grant reaches a holding client. Replaced with grant-while-held (mutex violation) and duplicate-acquire (Inv violation only).
title: The invariant is stronger than the property: it catches the lost-token bug that mutual exclusion alone misses, and it identifies which defensive checks are load-bearing (none of the sender checks are, with honest clients)
